broadcast_guide.description: A step-by-step summary of how to use the announcement wizard. Work through it from top to bottom to send your announcement.

audience.title: Who to reach (audience)
audience.body: Decide who gets to see the announcement (the first step).

steps.step1: Choose the audience: Members only / Supporters and above / Everyone (Public)
steps.step2: (Organization announcements only) Choose "All teams" or select specific teams

template.title: Save time with templates
template.body: You can load and save the recipient settings you use often.

steps.step1: Use "Load from template" to fill in the recipients automatically
steps.step2: (Admins only) Use "Save as template" to register the current audience (up to 20 per audience)

channel.title: Choose how to deliver it (channel)
channel.body: Pick one destination from Bulletin, Timeline, Blog, TODO, Schedule and Survey.

steps.step2: Click "Next". Note: if the template has a default channel, this screen is skipped

content.title: Write the content
content.body: The input fields change depending on the channel you chose. Fields marked * are required.

steps.step1: Fill in the required fields such as title and body
steps.step2: Example: Schedule requires a start date and time; Timeline requires a body

priority.title: Priority and expiry
priority.body: You can set how prominent the announcement is and when it stops being displayed.

steps.step1: (Admins and above) Choose the priority: Normal / Important / Urgent. Regular members are fixed to "Normal"

submit.title: Send and confirm
submit.body: Once everything is filled in you can send. After sending, it appears in announcements.

steps.step2: Confirm that it was sent. Note: survey questions and TODO assignees are added on their own screens after sending
